notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h3]🎮 [b]Gameplay Changes[/b]:[/h3][list][*][p]After purchasing a food stall, the player now needs to set a work schedule.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the interval at which customers leave after the stall closes.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked customer movement logic for a smoother approach to the order point.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a cooldown between customer visits to the same stall.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a trash mechanic: customers now leave garbage depending on their orders.[/p][/*][*][p]Customers will no longer sit at tables with trays or trash left behind.[/p][/*][*][p]Completely redesigned POS terminal mechanics: it can now be purchased, placed on a table, stored in the inventory, or mounted on different parts of the stall frame. Each option has a unique appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed item placement logic on puddled surfaces.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 [b]Visual Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Localization updates and fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved POS terminal feedback: it now shows which items are missing to serve customers with multi-orders.[/p][/*][*][p]Added automatic order updates in the POS terminal (no need to reopen the interface to see new orders).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect display of extra items and NPCs during stall customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted color correction settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked stall materials: chosen colors now appear more natural.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]“Join Discord”[/b] button in the main menu — added animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]“Support us on Kickstarter”[/b] button in the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔊 [b]Audio:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted volume and positioning for some city ambient sounds.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ [b]Technical Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with products on trays handed to customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed problems with work schedule settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected seating positions for customers at tables.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tray highlight positions when serving orders.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display of equipment taken from inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted customer spawn positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck inside the stall.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed entrance collider for the rental room in the car service area.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to trash elements.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: [h3]🎮 [b]Gameplay Changes[/b]:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Customers now remember the price of each item[/b] in their order.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Automatic opening of the shop based on working hours has been removed.[/b] Automatic closing remains.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manually or automatically closing the shop (by schedule)[/b] will gradually remove unserved customers, but [b]partially served customers can still be completed.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased interaction range[/b] for delivering orders, picking up, and placing items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New dialogue system with customers:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now [b]refuse service[/b] to a customer.[/p][/*][*][p]Customers already being served and sitting at a table will [b]not be available for dialogue.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Alternative dialogue is available for customers [b]whose orders are ready but not yet delivered.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Some NPCs with no available dialogue may now leave the area.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue choices can now be selected using number keys:[/b] 1, 2, 3 or Num1, Num2, Num3, etc.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 [b]Visual Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Animated sea movement.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Overhauled day-night cycle system.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked fog system.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed brightness issue on scene load.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual issues on the auto repair shop location have been fixed.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed various texture rendering issues.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Subtitle color updated[/b] to a more expressive shade for better readability in bright environments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added main quest objective marker display.[/b] [i](Requires a new game to display correctly.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed incorrect height rendering[/b] of the spilled coffee puddle.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔊 [b]Audio:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Menu and intro volume[/b] levels have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New footstep sound system[/b] with surface-based sound variety.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ [b]Technical Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed issue with phone button[/b] while entering player/shop names.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed game timer and time speed issue.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked in-game pause system.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New movement system for city residents.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New surface height detection system[/b] for pedestrians.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed memory leak issue[/b] during long play sessions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed repeated dialogues[/b] after reloading.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed issues with the tray[/b] used to serve customers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed menu navigation bug[/b] between phone screens (Shop & Purchases).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed display of zero-amount transactions.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed statistics saving issues.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed secondary quests reactivating unexpectedly.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed save/load issue for SMS messages on the phone.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed mechanic dialogue issue[/b] at the auto repair shop.[/p][/*][/list]
